$comment: The shelves the dispatcher workshop's industry chooser draws over data/dispatcher-profiles.json. A file of its own, not a block in that one, because that document is part of every run's configuration: the shipped fix-it mornings are pinned to a digest of it, and a heading on a shelf is not something a run depends on. Every shipped profile is on exactly one shelf, which packages/viz/src/authoring/dispatcherFamilies.test.ts holds, so adding a profile without shelving it fails a test rather than leaving it under 'more this build ships'. A line says what a family's designs share and never ranks one family over another: only a paired-t interval says that.

families.name: The basics
families.line: The designs lifts have used for decades. Each has one idea.

families.name: One thing first
families.line: Each puts one concern first and gives something up elsewhere.

families.name: Divide the tower
families.line: Each car looks after part of the building.

families.name: Ask where they are going
families.line: Riders pick their floor before boarding, so cars can be filled by destination.

families.name: Cars that bid
families.line: Each car bids on a call, and the bids decide which car goes.

families.name: Everything at once
families.line: Weighs many concerns together and forecasts where the crowd will be.
